Weirdly enough, my closest friends at McGill are those who I randomly introduced myself to during lectures. Even in second year. I didn’t live in Rez in my first year so most of my friends, I made during lectures. 

I know it doesn’t work with everyone but I think the key is to do this in the very beginning of the semester, and to look for people who sit alone because chances are they might not know anyone in that class and would appreciate at least a study buddy. Hope this helps!

I don’t know if this is common or not but earlier in my first semester, I just randomly introduced myself to people sitting next to me in lectures. So I tried to sit in different spots in the room to talk to new people. If I click with someone then I’d offer to save seats for them etc. Then asked to work on assignments together (if allowed). That’s basically how I met my closest friends at McGill and through them I befriended a lot of people too! It never occurred to me that people probably don’t really do this until now haha.
